title: cBCI Matrix Multimodal Dataset
description: This dataset contains simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking recordings from 21 healthy participants performing a matrix-based single-character-presentation BCI spelling task. Calibration and copy-spelling sessions include event markers for target and non-target stimuli. It supports research on multimodal sensor fusion for EEG-based brain-computer interface typing systems.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 24-channel DSI-24 dry electrode system (Wearable Sensing) at 300 Hz with linked-ear reference. Eye movements were recorded with a Tobii Pro Nano at 60 Hz. The matrix paradigm was run with BciPy, presenting letters at 4 Hz in inquiries of 10 letters (1 target, 9 non-target) after a target prompt and fixation. Trigger timing was verified with a photodiode.
